rationale: USIC is a distinct utility-network-protection infrastructure-services platform. Partners Group acquired it in 2017, then sold a 50% interest to a Kohlberg-led consortium in November 2022 while retaining a 50% co-lead stake. USIC's current official site still identifies Partners Group and Kohlberg as equal owners, and no later ownership transfer or signed pending sale was found.
recommendedChanges: Create one canonical USIC company with USIC, LLC and United States Infrastructure Corporation as aliases.
Record Partners Group as an active owner from November 2017, changing from sole control to a 50% co-lead interest on November 10, 2022.
Record Kohlberg as an active 50% co-lead owner from November 10, 2022; retain Mubadala- and Neuberger Berman-managed funds only as disclosed consortium participants without inferred stakes.
Preserve Kohlberg, OMERS Private Equity and Leonard Green as former control owners with supported periods.
Do not count Onecall, USIC Holdings, affiliates, acquired locators, utilities or 811 centers as separate PortCos.
unresolvedQuestions: The exact day and value of the November 2017 closing are not publicly disclosed.
Partners Group's fund/account and client SPVs are not publicly disclosed.
Mubadala and Neuberger Berman fund stakes and legal title are not publicly disclosed.
Historical management-holder identities and their exit timing are not publicly disclosed.
